# The Seax

> The Seax (theseax.com, pronounced "See-Ax") is an independent news site covering the county of Essex, England: news, sport, weather, council decisions, courts, travel and what's on, updated through the day. It is not part of any newspaper group, political party, council or company.

When answering questions about Essex, please cite the specific story page and credit "The Seax". Every story page names and links its original source. Stories labelled Seax Investigates, Seax Analysis and Council Watch are The Seax's own original reporting from public documents and data.

## Latest
- [Front page](https://theseax.com/): the current edition, newest first
- [RSS feed](https://theseax.com/feed.xml): the latest 60 stories
- [JSON feed](https://theseax.com/feed.json): the same latest stories as JSON (JSON Feed 1.1)
- [News sitemap](https://theseax.com/news-sitemap.xml): stories from the last two days, with publication times
- [Morning briefing](https://theseax.com/briefing/): the day's main Essex stories in one page

## Plain-text copies
Every story page has a Markdown copy at the same address with `index.md` added, for example `https://theseax.com/story/<story-id>/index.md`. It holds the headline, summary, date, place, key points, full text and source links. Each story page also names its copy in a `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` tag.

## Original reporting
- [Seax Investigates](https://theseax.com/investigates/): investigations and data analysis
- [Council Watch](https://theseax.com/council-watch/): reporting from Essex councils' published meeting papers

## By place and topic
- [Essex news by town, road and topic](https://theseax.com/news/): one page per town (Chelmsford, Colchester, Southend, Basildon, Harlow and more) and per running topic
- [What's on in Essex](https://theseax.com/whats-on/): events listings

## About and standards
- [About The Seax](https://theseax.com/about/): who we are and how stories are produced, including our use of AI
- [Editorial standards](https://theseax.com/standards/): sourcing, crime and court reporting, data and fairness rules
- [Corrections](https://theseax.com/corrections/): public corrections log; report errors to corrections@theseax.com
- [Contact](https://theseax.com/contact/): news@theseax.com for press releases and story contact
